why: The headline, standfirst, key points, body and both covers say Modi met Vice-President C P Radhakrishnan on Diwali morning and posted at 7:05 am and 7:15 am. The cited source (the ETV Bharat live blog) says Modi met Radhakrishnan at the Uprashtrapati Bhawan ON SATURDAY. 7:05 am and 7:15 am are only the blog's entry times, not the times of his posts. The cover stat '7:15 am: greetings exchanged with Vice-President' is false, and so is the '7:05 am' stat. The picture is also wrong: the main picture is an infographic of a clock time for a story about Narendra Modi, a named, well-known person. The NOPHOTO note says only 'no free photo unused in 7 days' and that PIB timed out, which does not mean no free photo exists. Also, the English line 'Elsewhere on Sunday, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh marked Diwali eve' is wrong because Diwali eve was Saturday.
